en: A vintage postcard featuring a whimsical illustration of a child in colorful, old-fashioned clothing and a large hat decorated with flowers, playing a brass instrument (tuba or euphonium). Musical notes and flowers are shown coming out of the instrument's bell. The background is a grassy field with flowers. There is ornate German text in the upper right and lower part of the card.
